snippet.title: Bel's Fanfare Official Trailer | #TheIndiePremier
snippet.description:
Set sail on an RPG defined by rich exploration and expressive combat. Step into the role of Bel, the newly appointed aura cleaner aboard The Witch of the Sea, a once-luxurious vessel hiding secrets beneath its once-luxurious halls.

Developed and published by Chibig.
